September 30, 2025

Dear Devon Castellanos,

Congratulations! This letter confirms our offer of a Headlamp Fellowship
through the DoD SkillBridge program, beginning 14 October and ending
approximately 8 January with duty at Copperline Rail Logistics.
They are located at 88 Switchyard Court, Marion, OH 43302.

Your initial direct supervisor will be Tomas Herrera, Senior Yard
Operations Manager at Copperline Rail Logistics.

Your role will be an Intermodal Operations Fellow.

Duties & Responsibilities:
- Shadow yard planners during morning switch planning
- Maintain accurate gate transaction logs
- Prepare the daily yard utilization summary

Copperline Rail Logistics intends to extend their own offer of employment
to strong performers at the conclusion of the fellowship.

We are excited to have you aboard.

Sincerely,

Signed by: Avery Coleman, Program Director, Headlamp
